prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual modular pixel game character components, transparent PNG atlas. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its specific contour thickness, head proportions, pixel color clusters, palette and rendering exactly. Create reusable separate body parts in this same art family, not full characters and not a mockup. Canvas 1536x1152, EXACT grid 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 equal cells. No grid, no lettering, no labels, no background, NO cast shadows, no floating decorations. Genuine transparent alpha. Keep generous 25% empty margin around every component; no component may touch cell borders. Same slightly elevated three-quarter view facing right as the reference. Lighting from upper left. These parts will be assembled by software.
ROW 1: HEAD MODULES only, including hair and short neck, no shoulders or torso. Column1 adult male short brown hair, brown moustache, cheerful; column2 compatible adult male head bald crown, gray side hair and gray beard; column3 adult female blonde hair bun and sunglasses atop head, gold earrings; column4 compatible adult female red bob haircut and freckles. Both male heads exactly same neck width and scale. Both female heads exactly same neck width and scale.
ROW 2: TORSO MODULES with BOTH arms/hands hanging naturally down, cropped at waist, neck opening, NO head, NO legs, NO held items. Column1 stocky male cream shirt and dark teal open denim vest; column2 exactly same stocky male body with white shirt and rust-red cook's apron ending at waist; column3 slim female orange blouse with floral pattern; column4 exactly same slim female body with moss-green utility jacket. Two male modules share identical neck and waist sockets, two female modules share identical neck and waist sockets.
ROW 3: LEG MODULES, waist to soles only, no head, no torso. Column1 stocky male brown trousers and brown work boots; column2 exactly same stance and proportions, navy trousers and tan work boots; column3 slim female dark green trousers and brown boots; column4 same slim female stance and proportions, dark blue jeans and tan boots. Both feet on same baseline. All modules have a neutral idle pose, not animations. Clearly visible clean cut planes at neck/waist for seamless assembly. Every component occupies ONLY its assigned cell. Avoid gradients, fuzzy shadows, any props, words, humanoid mannequins or whole characters. Match reference Dorfcomic.
